issues.what: The caption 'Can land somewhere fresh' runs to x=949 of 960 at half scale. The text ends 22 px from the right edge at 1080p, and the frame cuts off the chip's right border (seen on the 2x crop at f11550). This breaks the 64 px safe margin for about 40 frames, until the camera move carries it inward at 11584.
issues.fix: Anchor the label to the left of the fresh spots or right-align it at x ≤ 1856 at 1080p. Clamp hud anchors to the safe area while the camera is pushing.

issues.what: After the free-space overwrite (HDD_WIPED), cyan dashed threads with ring terminals still run from the card to 021–023, 058–060 and 098–100 across the all-grey wall (about 3,000 strong-cyan px per half-scale frame from 10400 to 10720). DIRECTION §2.3 says HDD_WIPED has no cyan. While the lab lens 'finds only grey', glowing cyan directions say the photo is still there, which undercuts 'Replaced in place'.
issues.fix: Fade or snap the threads at the end of the wave (about 10370; for example, threads off or reuse on 'photo'), or draw them grey once their boxes are overwritten.

issues.what: The P15 hero beat (the write is accepted but lands somewhere else) plays inside the half-width SSD panel at split zoom. Box 059 is about 14 px wide at half scale, and the stream is a 1–2 px hairline that bends 3 boxes right (f10144–10146). The planned push to 059 doesn't show. The panel also snaps back from SSD_ERASED (9941–10026) to SSD_DELETED, with the photo's cyan back, under the roll at 10046, with no cue.
issues.fix: Push the right panel to photoBoxes (≥ 2× zoom) for 10073–10168, or cut to a full-frame SSD for this beat. Make the reset readable, for example with a short rewind flick under the roll.

issues.what: The reported-speech strip 'NIST · flash with spare cells: writing over it can't reach every place old data was stored' is 16 words on 2 lines. The quote and strip cap is 12 words (§1.3). It's the §8 string, but it still breaks the cap.
issues.fix: Shorten it to ≤ 12 words, for example 'NIST: on flash, writing over it can't reach every old copy'. Do this together with the direction owner.

issues.what: The strip has curly quotes around 'Overwriting typically hinders the recovery of data', but the voice says 'overwriting typically hinders recovery'. 'the … of data' isn't spoken, so the §1.3 rule (verbatim in both the voice and the source) fails. The attribution line '— NIST, the US standards agency' has capitals about 11 px tall at half scale, under the 14 px floor.
issues.fix: Use reported speech, 'NIST: overwriting typically hinders recovery', or the quote '“Overwriting typically hinders … recovery”'. Set the source line at ≥ 40 px.

issues.what: The deflected write lands in a box with a coral outline. Coral means loss, but nothing is lost here; the point is that the photo's box 059 survives.
issues.fix: Use a white or grey ring for writes that land in fresh spots. Keep coral for writes that hit the photo's boxes.

method: I decoded frames only from out/ep06/v1/ep06_film.mp4, at half scale, and didn't play the video or listen to anything. I extracted [9935,17022] (7,088 frames, count verified) into out/ep06/review/v1/S7-S9/range.mp4. tools/static_check.py with --offset 9935 found 0 frozen stretches and 0 empty frames. A custom pass over the same range measured per-frame motion (m15 and m1), luma std (flagging 13729–13733, 14277–14336 and 14507–14517) and hard cuts. I viewed 11 images: tools/sheet.py overview sheets for S7 (every 30 frames, 69 frames), S8 (every 36, 78) and S9 (every 30, 77); dense sheets s7_a, s7_b, s8_a, s8_b, s9_a and s9_b (32–47 frames each, around word-locked beats and all 3 boundaries); and 2 crop composites of native half-scale crops at 1–2x (crops1, crops2). For legibility, a script measured connected-component capital heights at about 45 frames. Every must-read label was ≥ 14 px tall at half scale, with keywords and heroes at 26–65 px, except the S7 quote attribution (about 11 px). Other scripts measured label onset frames against TRANSCRIPT.md, counted cyan, amber and coral pixels at 10280–10720, 12960–13150 and 13470–13740, scanned the bottom 140 px band for text every 15 frames (only props and footnotes found), measured the right extent of the 'fresh' caption, and diffed the region at the 14747 cut. I rendered no full-resolution stills. I read PLAYBOOK §4–§8, DIRECTION (in full), TRANSCRIPT S7–S9, the ledger C15–C26 and the S7–S9 plans. All S7–S9 render logs have 0 [kit] warnings.
